### Solomon Builds the Temple
Author: Ligonier Ministries
Site: Ligonier Ministries
URL: https://learn.ligonier.org/devotionals/solomon-builds-the-temple
Passage: 2 Chronicles 3:1
Points:
- The design and golden adornments of Solomon's temple mirrored the majesty of God's heavenly palace.
- Carved cherubim reminded worshippers of joining the angels in reverent adoration of the Lord.
- The veil before the Most Holy Place echoed humanity's separation from God's presence after Eden.
- Constructing the sanctuary on Mount Moriah foreshadowed the ultimate atonement accomplished through Jesus Christ.
- Believers are called to approach God in both private and corporate worship with holy reverence and awe.
